turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Please send your order number and the email you used to place the order so I can check whether the print can be returned for a refund.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.
Your return and refund request for order SC-3744 needs staff review. I’ve passed it to a colleague who will take over and let you know the next steps.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Customer requests a return and refund for a print ordered in the wrong size. Return policy check for SC-3744 with claire.fontaine@example.com returned large_refund, requiring staff review. No return was filed.
